clips.title: The story
paras: Scavenging Deathknell is an early logistical task assigned to newly awakened Forsaken by Deathguard Saltain in Deathknell. As freshly raised undead claw their way from the soil, the Forsaken must scavenge abandoned boxes and crates throughout the blighted settlement to equip incoming recruits. It illustrates the raw scarcity facing Sylvanas's nascent people, who must reclaim discarded goods simply to survive.

Newly raised Forsaken awaken into a grim reality of decay and deprivation. Unlike established nations with bustling supply lines and armories, the free undead in Deathknell possess next to nothing. Deathguard Saltain's blunt demand reflects the ruthless practicality required to build an army from the graveyard dirt: every piece of salvageable cloth, leather, and iron must be hauled back to clothe and arm those still crawling out of their plots.

The settlement of Deathknell is littered with remnants of its former human inhabitants alongside supplies abandoned during the kingdom's fall to the Scourge. Rather than letting usable materials rot away in crates across town, the Deathguards press newborn undead into service as salvagers. As Saltain makes clear, the Forsaken expect no charity from the living world and must rely entirely on their own industriousness to stand on their feet.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!
Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones! I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us? There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside. No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work friend, I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
